premises.evidence_span: they cannot administer them without a rapid confirmation test

premises.text: Portable device types blood in three minutes anywhere outside traditional labs

premises.text: Cartridge microfluidics, device motion, and ML/CV algorithms deliver high accuracy suitable for FDA

premises.text: US and EU regulatory clearance is the commercialization path
premises.evidence_span: We are in the process of securing FDA and CMARC
